detail.title: 4MP 40x 5G Starlight WizMind Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD8A440PA-HNF-5G 4MP 40x 5G Starlight WizMind Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution • 40× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 500m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • 1/1.8" CMOS Sensor Ensures Premium Images • Supports 5G Communication and Can Be Used in Environments without Network • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.4 B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.4 0 lux(IR light on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –30° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; tracking; optimization; capturing pictures; uploading high-quality face snapshots Motor vehicle attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle type, vehicle color, vehicle logo, vehicle model/year, sun visor, seatbelt., smoking, calling, ornament, and annual inspection sticker. Non-motor vehicle attributes: Type, vehicle color, number of people, top type and color, and hat. Human body attributes: Top and bottom type and color, bag, hat, gender, and umbrella. Face attributes: Gender, age, facial expressions, glasses, face mask, and mustache.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; climbing fences; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Recognition: Supports face detection, optimization, tracking, capturing pictures, uploading high-quality face snapshots, and face enhancement; Supports attributes extraction. 6 attributes and 8 expressions: Gender, age, glasses, expressions (angry, sad, hate, scary, surprise, calm, happy and confused), mask, mustache; Supports face cutout: Face, one-inch photo. Capturing strategies include real-time capturing, optimization, and quality first Supports up to 5 face databases; registers person one by one or in batches; sets face similarity; compares faces with 10,000 faces.
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; MJPEG(Sub Stream); Smart H.264+; H.264M
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 4M/1080p/1.3M/720p (1–50/60 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/CIF (1–50/60 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p (1–50/60 fps)
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; ATW; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Max Transmission Power: 5G: Power class2: 26 dBm +2/-3dB Power class3: 23 dBm ± 2 dB 4G: Power class2: 26 dBm +2/-3 dB Power class3: 23 dBm ± 2 dB 3G: Power class3: 24 dBm +1/-3 dB
General.Network Protocol: TCP; FTP; RTMP; IPv6; IPv4; DNS; RTCP; PPPoE; NTP; RTP; 802.1x; HTTPS; SNMP; DDNS; UPnP; ICMP; UDP; IGMP; HTTP; DHCP; SMTP; SNMPv1/v2c/v3(MIB-2); Qos; RTSP; ARP
General.Storage: FTP; Micro SD card (512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions iOS 10 and later versions
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; tour; pattern; recordings; alarm digital input; send email
General.Alarm Event: Motion/Tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 22 W Max.: 53 W (illuminator + PTZ + pulling stream in 5G)
General.Protection: IP67, TVS 8000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
